title: Clean-Substrate Memory Architecture
description: Defines the storage hierarchy between machine-logic (json/py) and human-reflection (md).

values.name: Machine-First Storage
values.rule: Logical artifacts are stored primarily in 'json/' and 'py/'. These are the 'Source of Truth' for the swarm.
values.rationale: Ensures that every piece of firm knowledge is structured for automated discovery and forensic auditing.

values.name: Human-Viewing Layer
values.rule: Markdown files in 'md/' act as refined, human-centric portals into the machine-substrate. They contain copies of essential summaries or legislative 'Chords.'
values.rationale: Prioritizes the Rider's cognitive bandwidth by keeping the viewing layer lean and high-signal.

values.name: Single Sequestration Zone
values.rule: All unwanted, decommissioned, or high-entropy artifacts MUST be moved to 'repos/diy-make/memory/trash/'. No other trash or hidden zones are permitted.
values.rationale: Consolidates metabolic residue into a single, understood location for future forensic purging or recovery.

values.name: Eukaryotic Sync Layer
values.rule: Big files and high-entropy blobs are stored via Google Drive layer to maintain Git low-latency.
values.rationale: Prevents repository bloating and maintains session responsiveness.
